description.value: Ryuu Japanese Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant serving authentic home-style Japanese cuisine with a UBC campus location on University Boulevard. It is one of three Ryuu locations in Vancouver and offers online ordering with a loyalty rewards program. Cyclists navigating the UBC area will find it a convenient dine-in or takeout option.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; rack at 13m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 29m; rack (28 spaces) at 35m; stands (4 spaces) at 38m; stands (10 spaces) at 92m. Total: 44 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at ryuuorder.com confirms this is the UBC location of Ryuu Japanese Kitchen at 5980 University Blvd, matching the OSM address. The site prominently features an online ordering system ('ORDER NOW'), confirming takeout is available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Website page title reads 'Japanese Restaurant on Seymour and Robson, Vancouver', referencing the downtown location, while the OSM record is for the UBC branch — the site does list the UBC location separately so this is a minor branding quirk, not a mismatch.
No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, multi-location Japanese restaurant confirmed by website with UBC location matching OSM address; suitable for inclusion as a food stop for touring cyclists in the UBC area.

wow_evidence: one of three Ryuu locations in Vancouver
